my last three or four interactions with Abbey Medical Practice, I have been left frustrated and disappointed.

On one occasion, I arrived just three minutes late for a B12 injection and was refused by the nurse. I had to escalate the matter just to be seen. Meanwhile, I have often been kept waiting more than 30 minutes for appointments myself — the double standards are staggering.

Today, I called regarding an urgent pain issue and, to my surprise, received a same-day callback — something I genuinely appreciated. Unfortunately, it was from Dr. Perkins, who already has a reputation in the community for rudeness. This was not my first poor experience with him, and I know from friends and colleagues at the practice that it is a common complaint.

During our call, he showed no empathy for the challenges of everyday life, dismissed my concerns, and simply prescribed medication. His only advice amounted to “get some rest” alongside a prescription. There was no meaningful guidance or practical support.

Frankly, I find it alarming that Dr. Perkins is still allowed to practice medicine given his lack of professionalism, courtesy, and genuine patient
